title: "Trying to publish message on the topic, but the publisher is not activated" in ROS 2 lifecycle nodes: on_activate overrides, rclpy's silent drop and configure/activate in launch, measured
excerpt: Why a ROS 2 lifecycle publisher sends nothing: node never configured or activated, or an on_activate override that skips the base class. The C++ warning prints once per inactive stretch, rclpy logs nothing. Launch events and autostart compared on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
